name: app-owns-data-starter-kit-runner
description: Root runner that starts the Web API, Admin portal and React client concurrently.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n API,ADMIN,REACT -c green,magenta,cyan "dotnet run --project AppOwnsDataWebApi/AppOwnsDataWebApi.csproj" "dotnet run --project AppOwnsDataAdmin/AppOwnsDataAdmin.csproj" "npm --prefix AppOwnsDataReactClient start"
scripts.watch: concurrently -k -n API,ADMIN,REACT -c green,magenta,cyan "dotnet watch --project AppOwnsDataWebApi/AppOwnsDataWebApi.csproj run" "dotnet watch --project AppOwnsDataAdmin/AppOwnsDataAdmin.csproj run" "npm --prefix AppOwnsDataReactClient start"
